claim: The Kuwait Visa portal's family visit visa is for people visiting family members who live in Kuwait, and usually needs the relative in Kuwait to submit the request.
quote: This visa usually requires a family member residing in the host country to submit a request to visit their family members

claim: For a business visit visa, a local company must apply, with proof of the business purpose of the visit.
quote: A local company is required to apply for a business visit with proof of the business purpose of the visit

claim: A government visa is issued on an official invitation from the host government, for officials or government employees on official business.
quote: It is issued upon an official invitation from the host government and is subject to certain diplomatic protocols

claim: When the portal's nationality check finds an applicant not eligible for the online e-visa, it tells them they can apply through a Kuwait embassy instead.
quote: Applicant is not eligible for applying online e-visa, However you can apply through Kuwait embassy
note: What the check shows for Bangladesh was not verified (portal API not queried).

claim: The portal can also show an applicant that they are not eligible for an e-visa at all.
quote: Applicant is not eligible for applying e-visa

claim: The portal publishes a list of countries whose nationals get a tourist e-visa or visa on arrival; Bangladesh is not on it.
quote: Countries Eligible for E-Visa or Visa on Arrival:
value: list of about 53 countries, not Bangladesh
note: Full list in source: Spain ... Netherlands; Bangladesh absent.

claim: GCC residents can get the tourist visa only in listed professions such as doctors, pharmacists, lawyers, engineers, consultants, university professors, journalists, pilots, systems analysts, programmers, managers and businessmen.
quote: Doctors, pharmacists, lawyers, engineers, consultants, judges and prosecutors, university professors, journalists and media professionals, pilots, systems analysts, computer programmers, managers, businessmen

claim: Tourist visa documents: passport copy, GCC residence copy showing the profession (for GCC residents), confirmed ticket, hotel reservation and a recent face photo.
quote: Copy of the passport. Copy of the GCC residency for residents of GCC countries, clearly indicating the profession. Confirmed travel ticket. Hotel reservation. Recent face photo
value: passport, GCC residence, ticket, hotel, photo

claim: Visit visas need a passport valid at least 6 months.
quote: Passport validity: No less than 6 months

claim: A visit entry permit must be used within 30 days of issue.
quote: Entry permit validity: 30 days from the date of issuance

claim: On a government, family or private visit permit, the stay is no more than 30 days from entry, single entry, according to the portal.
quote: Stay duration: No more than 30 days from the date of entry
note: The 2025 regulation text allows up to three months for family visits; see V-reg ids.

claim: A visit visa holder may not work and must leave when the visit period ends.
quote: The visa holder is prohibited from working and must leave the country upon the expiration of the visit period

claim: Overstaying a visit visa is fined 10 KWD a day and the visitor may be banned from re-entering Kuwait.
quote: a fine of 10 Kuwaiti Dinars per day will be imposed, and the visitor may be banned from entering Kuwait in the future

claim: The portal's tourist visa instructions still give the visa fee as 3 KWD (its fee table also lists 3 KWD for family, business and government visits and 2 KWD for transit).
quote: The tourist visa fee is 3 Kuwaiti Dinars
note: Conflicts with KWD 10 per month under Ministerial Decision 2249/2025 (Gulf News, Al-Rai, Arab Times ids).

claim: All visa fees collected are non-refundable.
quote: All collected amounts are non-refundable

claim: The portal says visa fees are not collected unless the application is accepted.
quote: Visa fees will not be collected unless your application has been accepted

claim: If an application is rejected, the portal gives the reason where possible, and the applicant may submit a new application.
quote: You may submit a new application after reviewing the requirements and ensuring that all information is accurate

claim: Tourist visas typically take 1 to 2 business days to process.
quote: Tourist visas typically take between 1 and 2 business days

claim: Kuwait can reject or cancel an application or visa at any time, even after issue, without giving reasons.
quote: Kuwaiti authorities reserve the right to reject or cancel the application or visa at any time, even after issuance, without providing reasons

claim: Applications must be submitted only through the official website.
quote: Applications must be submitted through the official website only

claim: Applicants track their application by logging in to their account on the portal; status emails are also sent.
quote: You can track the status of your application by logging into your account on our website

claim: Fees are paid online by credit card or other secure online payment options.
quote: We accept payment via credit card as well as other secure online payment options

claim: The photo must be a JPEG or JPG file.
quote: Only JPEG or JPG images must be used

claim: The photo file must not exceed 2 MB.
quote: The size of the photo should not be more than 2 MB

claim: The photo must be less than 12 months old.
quote: Your application photo must be less than 12 months old from the time of applying

claim: The photo must be in colour against a plain white or light grey background.
quote: The Photo must be taken against a plain white or light grey background

claim: Applicants register on the portal and activate the account by email before logging in.
quote: Activate your account via email

claim: A sponsor in Kuwait applying for a family visit must have a Civil ID in the profile and authenticate with Kuwait Mobile ID.
quote: Please Update Your CivilId in your Profile to Authenticate your Kuwait Mobile Id

claim: The portal's office is the Electronic Services Department of the General Administration of Residence Affairs in Dajeej, Kuwait.
quote: General Administration of Residence Affairs - Electronic Services Department

claim: The office receives visitors Sunday to Thursday, 8:00 am to 2:00 pm Kuwait time; online and email requests are handled 24/7.
quote: Reception of visitors on site from Sunday to Thursday, from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm (Kuwait time)

claim: A transit visa holder must have a visa for the destination country.
quote: The visa holder must have a visa for the destination country they are traveling to

claim: The portal's list of visit purposes includes medical treatment.
quote: Medical treatment

claim: Holders of residency entry permits (work, dependant, study) must give a Kuwaiti embassy a home-country criminal record certificate not older than 90 days.
quote: must visit the Kuwaiti embassy or consulate in their country to provide a criminal record certificate issued by the authorities of their home country, with no more than 90 days since issuance

claim: If the entry permit details do not match the passport, the permit is invalid and the holder is refused entry.
quote: If the details of the entry permit do not match the passport details, the entry permit will be considered invalid, and the holder will not be allowed to enter the country

claim: Under the 2025 executive regulations, a family visit visa is issued at the request of a citizen or resident and allows a stay of up to three months.
quote: سمة دخول زيارة عائلية، وتصدر بناء على طلب أحد المواطنين أو المقيمين، وتجيز للزائر البقاء في دولة الكويت لمدة لا تزيد على ثلاثة أشهر.
note: Official text in Kuwait Al-Youm not saved; listed as blocked.

claim: A private visit visa is also issued at the request of a citizen or resident, for up to three months.
quote: سمة دخول زيارة خاصة، وتصدر بناء على طلب أحد المواطنين أو المقيمين، وتجيز للزائر البقاء في دولة الكويت لمدة لا تزيد على ثلاثة أشهر.

claim: A business visit visa is issued at the request of a company or commercial establishment and allows a stay of up to one month.
quote: سمة دخول زيارة تجارية، وتصدر بناء على طلب إحدى الشركات أو المؤسسات التجارية، وتجيز للزائر البقاء في دولة الكويت لمدة لا تزيد على شهر.

claim: A government visit visa is issued at the request of a government body or public institution and allows a stay of up to three months.
quote: سمة دخول زيارة حكومية، وتصدر بناء على طلب إحدى الجهات الحكومية أو المؤسسات والهيئات العامة، وتجيز للزائر البقاء في دولة الكويت لمدة لا تزيد على ثلاثة أشهر.

claim: A medical treatment visit visa is issued on a certificate from the Ministry of Health, or from a private hospital certified by the Ministry of Health, proving the person is accepted for treatment; stay up to three months.
quote: سمة دخول زيارة للعلاج، وتصدر بناء على شهادة صادرة من وزارة الصحة، أو أحد المستشفيات الخاصة بشرط التصديق عليها من وزارة الصحة، تثبت قبول الأجنبي للعلاج بها، وتجيز للزائر البقاء في دولة الكويت لمدة لا تزيد على ثلاثة أشهر.
value: MOH or MOH-certified private hospital acceptance; 3 months

claim: A multiple-entry visit visa lasts up to one year, with each stay limited to one month from each entry.
quote: على ألا تزيد مدة بقائه في دولة الكويت على شهر واحد من تاريخ كل حركة دخول.

claim: A tourist visa is issued by the General Administration of Residence Affairs at the applicant's request, or at any Kuwaiti port of entry or Kuwaiti consulate abroad, for a stay of up to three months.
quote: سمة دخول زيارة للسياحة، وتصدر من الإدارة العامة لشؤون الإقامة بناء على طلب صاحب الشأن، ويجوز إصدارها من أي منفذ من منافذ الكويت أو من القنصليات الكويتية في الخارج، وتجيز للزائر البقاء في دولة الكويت لمدة لا تزيد على ثلاثة أشهر.

claim: A transit visa requires the traveller to state where they come from and where they are going, to hold a visa for the destination, and to stay no more than seven days.
quote: وبشرط أن يكون حاملاً لتأشيرة دخول البلد المتجه إليه، وألا تزيد مدة بقائه في دولة الكويت على سبعة أيام.

claim: An emergency entry visa is issued at a port of entry in emergencies, and the holder must leave within seven days.
quote: سمة دخول طارئة، وتصدر من أي منفذ من منافذ الكويت في الأحوال الطارئة، ويتعين على حاملها مغادرة دولة الكويت خلال سبعة أيام من تاريخ الدخول.

claim: A study entry visa is issued at the request of a government educational body or a private university, stating that the student has been accepted.
quote: سمة دخول للدراسة، وتصدر بناء على طلب إحدى الجهات التعليمية الحكومية، أو الجامعات الخاصة، مبيناً به قبول الطالب للدراسة بها.
value: government education body or private university

claim: Study residence is granted at the request of a government educational body or private university with a certified certificate of admission; renewal needs a certificate that the student is still studying.
quote: يجوز منح الإقامة العادية للأجنبي للدراسة بناء على طلب يقدم من إحدى الجهات التعليمية الحكومية أو الجامعات الخاصة مرفقاً به شهادة منها تثبت قبوله للدراسة بها مصدقة من الجهات المختصة

claim: The Director General of Residence Affairs sets the rules for converting a study residence to another purpose.
quote: ويختص مدير عام الإدارة العامة لشؤون الإقامة بتحديد الضوابط المطلوبة لتحويل هذه الإقامة إلى غرض آخر.

claim: A residence can be changed from one type or purpose to another under rules set by the General Administration of Residence Affairs.
quote: ويجوز تحويل الإقامة من نوع إلى آخر، جاوز ومن غرض إلى آخر، وفق الضوابط التي تحددها الإدارة العامة لشؤون الإقامة.

claim: A person entering on a residence entry visa (work, dependant, study and so on) may stay up to two months and must complete the residence procedures in that time.
quote: البقاء فيها لمدة لا تزيد على شهرين من تاريخ دخوله لها

claim: Only nationals of countries named by decree, on a reciprocal basis, are exempt from needing an entry visa.
quote: ويعفى من الحصول على سمة الدخول رعايا الدول التي يصدر بها مرسوم بناء على عرض وزير الداخلية وبشرط المعاملة بالمثل.

claim: Getting, renewing or transferring a residence requires proof of Ministry of Health health insurance in the person's name.
quote: إثبات التسجيل في نظام الضمان الصحي أو التأمين الصحي الصادر من وزارة الصحة باسم المكفول

claim: Article 39 of the 2025 regulations sets a fee of 10 KWD per month for nine kinds of visit visa (government, business, family, private, medical, multiple-entry, tourism, sports, cultural or social).
quote: وحدّدت المادة رسم 10 د.ك لـ 9 أنواع من سمات الدخول للزيارة على أن يكون الرسم لكل شهر.

claim: Transit, truck/bus driver and emergency entry visas cost 10 KWD each.
quote: كما يبلغ الرسم 10 د.ك أيضاً لـ 3 أنواع أخرى من التأشيرات: سمة الدخول للمرور وسمة دخول سائقي مركبات النقل (الشاحنات - الباصات) وسمة الدخول الطارئة.

claim: Extending a visit under Article 15 costs 10 KWD per month.
quote: تمديد مدة الزيارة وفق (المادة 15): 10 دنانير عن كل شهر

claim: Under Article 15 a visit can be extended by up to three months at a time, renewable, up to one year in total.
quote: تمديد مدة سمة الدخول بما لا يزيد على ثلاثة أشهر، ويجوز تجديد هذه السمة لمدد مماثلة، وبما لا يجاوز سنة واحدة.
value: 3 months at a time, max 1 year

claim: Article 16 allows a visit visa to be turned into a work residence only for government visit visas.
quote: حيث يمكن تحويل الزيارة إلى إقامة عمل حصراً في الزيارة الحكومية

claim: Residence for foreign students costs 20 KWD (the same as government and private-sector work residence).
quote: حددت 20 ديناراً رسوم إقامة للعمل بالقطاعين الحكومي والأهلي وللطلبة الأجانب

claim: Under Ministerial Decision No. 2249/2025, entry and visit visas cost 10 KWD per month from 23 December 2025.
quote: Kuwait has set the cost of entry and visit visas at KD 10 per month under new executive regulations governing the residence of foreigners, which came into force on Tuesday, December 23

claim: The rules are in Ministerial Decision No. 2249/2025, the executive regulations of the Decree-Law on the Residence of Foreigners.
quote: The changes were introduced under Ministerial Decision No. 2249/2025

claim: The Director General of Residency Affairs, Brigadier General Mazyad Al-Mutairi, said fees for all work and visit visas are 10 KWD per month.
quote: He affirmed that the fees for all types of work and visit visas have been set at KD 10 per month.

claim: Residency Affairs issues 17,000 to 20,000 visit visas a week (family, business and tourist).
quote: the department issues between 17,000 and 20,000 visit visas weekly

claim: The new rules have nine types of residence visa and twelve types of visit visa.
quote: now categorized into nine types of residency visas and twelve types of visit visas

claim: Fragomen reports entry visas (work, family visit, tourism, medical) rose to 10 KWD per month of stay from earlier rates of 1-3 KWD.
quote: KWD 10 per month of stay, up from the previous variable lower rates

claim: The maximum stay for visitors rose to three months from one month.
quote: The maximum duration of stay for visitors is now three months (up from the previous one month).

claim: A GCC unified tourist visa ('GCC Grand Tours') was expected to launch possibly in 2026.
quote: Current expectations are for the visa to potentially be launched in 2026.

claim: From 23 December 2025 visitors must have health insurance from approved private companies.
quote: requiring visitors to obtain health insurance from approved private companies

claim: The insurance is paid by the sponsor in Kuwait or by the visitor.
quote: The amount must be paid by the Kuwaiti sponsor or the visitor.

claim: People arriving on entry visas for residence (such as work) pay 5 KWD a month for health insurance.
quote: It imposes a monthly fee of KD 5 for expats who arrive on entry visas seeking permanent residency

claim: Students pay 100 KWD a year in government health insurance.
quote: Others who must pay KD 100 for government health insurance include investors, commercial partners, students

claim: Since August 2025, all expatriates living in Kuwait can bring extended family on a visit visa; the salary requirement was abolished.
quote: All expatriates living in Kuwait can bring their extended families on a visit visa to Kuwait as the salary requirement has been abolished

claim: A complete application can be issued in five minutes.
quote: Kandari said that if the application is complete, the visa will be issued within just five minutes.

claim: The rule that visitors must fly Kuwait Airways or Jazeera Airways was abolished; visitors can come by sea, land or air on any carrier.
quote: Kuwait has also abolished the requirement that visitors to Kuwait must use Kuwaiti carriers, either Kuwait Airways or Al-Jazeera Airways.

claim: Visa fees depend on nationality.
quote: Col Kandari said fees on visas depend on each nationality.

claim: Kuwait Times reported that a ministerial decision removed the profession requirement for the GCC/US/UK/Schengen resident category.
quote: although a decision by the interior minister issued on Sunday removed the profession requirement
note: Portal text (p_gcc_professions) and Arab Times 2025-10-16 (at235_gcc) still describe profession-limited eligibility.

claim: Family visit visas can be single entry for one, two or three months, or multiple entry for three months to a year with each stay up to one month.
quote: family visas can be for a single entry for one month, or two months or three months

claim: Usually only a birth certificate is needed to prove the relationship; some cases need a marriage certificate.
quote: For a majority of applications only a birth certificate is required and a marriage certificate is needed for some cases to establish the relationship.

claim: All documents must be in Arabic or translated into Arabic by authorised offices.
quote: Col Kandari said that all documents must be in Arabic and documents in other languages must be translated into Arabic from authorized offices.

claim: Applicants must give their address in Kuwait or their hosts' address.
quote: Kundari said that applicants must also state their address in Kuwait or the address of their hosts.

claim: Relatives who can be invited include wives, children, parents, parents-in-law, aunts and uncles, brothers and sisters, nephews and nieces and grandparents.
quote: from wives, children, parents to parents of the wife, aunts and uncles, brothers and sisters, nephews and nieces, grandfathers and grandmothers

claim: All visa types are open to all nationalities except Israelis.
quote: Kandari said that all types of visas are open to all nationalities except for the Israeli nationality which is barred by an Amiri decree.

claim: The third tourist category (other nationals proving financial solvency with a bank statement and hotel booking) had not yet come into effect in August 2025.
quote: The third category, which has not yet come into effect and is currently under development

quote: Al-Kandari stressed that no nationality is categorically barred from entering Kuwait if requirements are met.

claim: The Kuwait Visa platform is a website and a mobile app offering tourist, family visit, government visit and business visas.
quote: The platform is available as both a website and a mobile application, currently offering four visa types: tourist, family visit, government visit, and business visas.

claim: Visitors who fail the security check on arrival are refused entry and sent back.
quote: Visitors who fail to meet security requirements will be denied entry and returned to their country.

quote: the visa system has been opened to all nationalities, lifting previous restrictions that had limited entry for certain countries

quote: with concerns about approving visas for expatriates whose monthly salaries are very low — for instance, those earning 250 Kuwaiti dinars or slightly above or below

quote: anyone caught performing work will be deported along with their sponsor and added to the ban list, preventing re-entry into the country

claim: About 235,000 visit visas were approved from the platform's launch to mid-October 2025.
quote: approximately 235,000 visit visas

claim: There is no longer an age limit on bringing parents over 60 on a family visit visa.
quote: No, there is no longer an age limit preventing expats from bringing in parents who are above 60 on a family visit visa in Kuwait.

claim: Interior Ministry Decision No. 1091 of 2026 (published in Kuwait Al-Youm, August 2026) added a 150 KWD fee for converting a visit entry visa into a regular residence under Article 16.
quote: requiring applicants to pay KD150 when converting a visit entry visa into a regular residence permit

claim: The fee was set by Ministry of Interior Decision No. 1091 of 2026, amending Ministerial Decision No. 2249 of 2025.
quote: Ministry of Interior Decision No. 1091 of 2026, which amends provisions of Ministerial Decision No. 2249 of 2025

claim: Domestic workers and similar categories are exempt from the conversion fee.
quote: domestic workers and individuals in equivalent categories would be exempt from the fee

claim: Hundreds of conversion applications were rejected in August 2026 because applicants did not meet the conditions.
quote: Hundreds of expatriates in Kuwait have had applications to convert visit visas into residency permits rejected

quote: may convert visit visas for spouses, sons under 18 and daughters under 21 if they earn a minimum monthly salary of KD800

claim: Visit visas issued to spouses and children cannot be converted into Article 18 work permits.
quote: visit visas issued for spouses and children cannot be converted into Article 18 work permits

claim: In January 2026 typing centres reported that visit-to-dependant conversion was not yet available in practice.
quote: many typing centres report that the conversion option is not yet available in practice

quote: Bangladeshi citizens are now receiving visa facilities from Kuwait without requiring any special approval

quote: the ambassador has issued a strong warning against any attempts at visa forgery

quote: পাকিস্তান, ইরাক, ইয়েমেন, ইরান, সিরিয়া ও সুদান এ ৬টি দেশের নাগরিকদেরও বাণিজ্যিক, ফ্যামেলি, ভ্রমণ ভিসা নিতে লাগবে মন্ত্রণালয়ের বিশেষ অনুমতি।

claim: A Bangla report (August 2025) says people on tourist and family visas cannot change to a work visa or work.
quote: ট্যুরিস্ট ভিসায় ও ফ্যামিলি ভিসায় এসে কাজের ভিসায় পরিবর্তন বা কাজ করার সুযোগ নেই এই ভিসায়।

claim: In January 2024 Kuwait University charged international students 100 KWD per credit unit plus a 10 KWD application fee, and planned to accept at least 300.
quote: which is KD100 for each unit of study, and the application fee is KD10

claim: The face photo must be 40mm high by 30mm wide.
quote: Photo must be in dimension of 40mm (height) x 30mm (width)

claim: The portal lists an entry permit for study among residency entry permits.
quote: Entry Permit for Study

quote: وإذا رغب الأجنبي في تجديد السمة فعليه أن يقدم طلباً بذلك قبل انتهاء مدتها.

claim: Case 1: people on a government visit visa to a ministry or public body, limited to university graduates and technical specialists, with the Director General's approval.
quote: ويقتصر ذلك على حملة المؤهلات الجامعية وأصحاب التخصصات الفنية، وذلك بموافقة مدير عام الإدارة العامة لشؤون الإقامة.

quote: 5 - للحالات الأخرى التي يُقدّرها مدير عام الإدارة العامة لشؤون الإقامة.
